title_format: Replay-level dispersion of {n} shots, varied: {inputs}. Aim: address line

sources.preset: Hole preset of golf_environment/shots_settings.json; the same par 4 as the single-shot hole view, whose 380 m fairway holds a driver carry. Illustrative, not surveyed.
sources.mean_marker: Matplotlib marker of the mean landing point (a star stands out from the round carry dots).
sources.mean_marker_size: Size in points of the mean landing marker, larger than the 9 point carry dots of the hole figure.
sources.mean_rgb: Colour of the mean landing marker, near black for contrast on the fairway.
sources.ellipse_rgb: Edge and fill colour of the spread ellipse.
sources.ellipse_fill_alpha: Fill opacity of the spread ellipse, low so traces underneath stay visible.
sources.ellipse_edge_alpha: Edge opacity of the spread ellipse.
sources.ellipse_linewidth: Edge width in points of the spread ellipse.
sources.figure: Figure size in inches and resolution, replacing the figure block of shots_settings.json; matches the hole view still in proportion.
sources.input_names: Plain-language names of the varied shot-setup inputs (shot_dispersion.INPUTS) for the title.
sources.title_format: Second title line: states a replay-level dispersion (not a physical or measured one), the varied inputs and that the hole is aimed along the address line since a dispersion has no single finish line.
sources.legend_format: Legend lines; the nominal shot is the replay of the base club roll and ball shift the samples vary around, drawn like the export's shot over the sample traces (colours, widths and order: dispersion_traces_settings.json and hole_view_settings.json); the stats line is mean +/- population standard deviation of the flight model's carry and side in display units (side positive to the right).
